title: Daily Three-Index Cross-Relative Convergence Sleeve in the Shared Portfolio

research_height.transfer_path: one fixed daily three-index relative-return mechanism -> two appended lifecycle-producing components -> actual shared-account turnover, stressed value, native-component preservation and equity drawdown

central_question: Can one fixed daily H1 convergence sleeve, appending US30 and US500 together after the unchanged six native components, lift actual first fills to at least three per normal FPMarkets trading day in both binding-long and isolated-latest evidence while adding positive 2x-cost value, preserving the native book and avoiding material drawdown deterioration under the current 4 percent position-risk and 12 percent aggregate-risk contract?

research_bundle.name: control_vs_dual_append_shared_account_matrix

variants.CONTROL: the unchanged six-component forward portfolio under a new Unit 093 Tester identity
variants.DUAL_APPEND: the same six components followed by the frozen US30 and US500 convergence components as one inseparable sleeve

lenses: turnover: actual lifecycle-starting first fills per zero-day-retaining normal-day denominator
economics: whole-portfolio and appended-component stressed 2x-cost net
shared-capital externality: native-six births and stressed net retained versus immediately adjacent CONTROL
risk: actual maximum equity drawdown, stopped lifecycles, risk admission and aggregate planned risk

why_now.current_bottleneck: Unit 085 proved that the existing six components cannot reach three lifecycle starts per normal day because the dominant shortfall is upstream native-signal supply. Its one initially proposed deficit-day proxy was consumed by failed Unit 086, so another transform of that proxy is forbidden.
why_now.new_material_evidence: A continuity-authorized exact legacy anchor contains a separately developed US30 H1 convergence executable selected on 2018-2023 and observed with 100 percent real ticks in 2024 through 2026-08-12. It has never been integrated into the Next shared portfolio, never used current protective-stop or aggregate-risk semantics and never supplied a US500 sleeve component.
why_now.connection_bridge: The anchored US30 executable supplies a concrete independent lifecycle-producing mechanism, while the symmetric US500 member makes the related three-index convergence hypothesis one complete symbol bundle rather than a later adjacent-symbol rescue.
why_now.perspective_distance_from_unit_086: Unit 086 conditioned on completed signal-deficit days, measured a 12:00-to-18:00 raw median displacement, selected one existing US30 or US100 book, proxied 19:00-to-23:00 reversion and opened no executable. Unit 093 uses no deficit state, no daily selector and no proxy exit; it freezes a pre-existing 17:00 one-H1 residual normalized by 120 H1 observations, appends two new executable components on every eligible day and judges actual shared-account first fills and broker-cost outcomes.
why_now.decision_if_true: Retain the exact DUAL_APPEND profile as one prospective-only Lab candidate requiring genuinely later uncontaminated evidence. Do not promote or change Live.
why_now.decision_if_false: Preserve the six-component forward baseline and close the entire US30-US500 convergence sleeve without a single-symbol, threshold, hour, hold, direction, scale, peer or risk rescue.
why_now.decision_if_invalid: Correct demonstrable implementation defects without a numeric repair cap; if the frozen semantic, data, fingerprint or topology contract genuinely cannot be satisfied, preserve the baseline and close with no economic verdict.

whole_map_recomparison.program_1: Selected only after the valid Unit 045 null because the exact legacy anchor supplies a newly material executable mechanism and direct three-start portfolio bridge, not another CP2 state cut.
whole_map_recomparison.program_2: Recent concentration plus corrected Unit 045 null and Unit 092 ambiguity weigh strongly against another external state.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: No dense new order, priority, occupancy, latency, handoff or session role is ready; Unit 093 retains the inherited fixed 17:00 clock rather than studying it.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: Corrected Unit 046 retained a diagnostic adverse marker but no causal management successor.
whole_map_recomparison.program_5: Unit 061 requires a semantic reconstruction change and Unit 075 lacks complete binding data; Unit 093 measures shared-capital effects but does not allocate to Program 5.
whole_map_recomparison.program_7: No diagnostic or meta result currently changes a portfolio decision; the legacy degradation audit contains only two safe later outcomes and cannot support a model.
whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 and all heights. Do not automatically open any convergence or adjacent portfolio successor.

requirements: The declaration, baseline commit/manifest, all project pins, legacy commit/blob pins and retention receipt remain exact.
The self-contained family source, SET/INI configuration, compile receipt and runtime receipt are committed and pushed before the first valid matrix path.
MetaEditor reports zero errors and zero warnings and the compiled EX5 hash stays fixed for all four paths.
Every path uses Model=4, reports 100 percent real ticks, stops normally and has no required-symbol discontinuity that breaks the declared continuous interval.

Before and after each immediately adjacent CONTROL/DUAL_APPEND pair, terminal build, exercised history hashes, symbols-*.dat hashes and US30/US100/US500 contract and swap fingerprints are equal; any mid-pair change discards the matrix and requires a clean full rerun.

Every path logs its exact profile, release, portfolio and eight-component identity table; CONTROL creates zero appended signal/open lifecycle and DUAL_APPEND processes US30 before US500 only after the native six.
Every lifecycle birth has exactly one final CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE, every final has positive planned risk and all economic values are finite.

All four paths finish with zero safety, persistence, broker-mismatch, foreign-exposure, protection, dropped-record or nonfinite-economic fault and aggregate planned risk never exceeds the frozen 12 percent cap.

BINDING_LONG contains at least 600 normal days and at least 100 births from each appended component; ISOLATED_LATEST contains at least 35 normal days and at least 15 births from each appended component.
Actual lifecycle-starting first fills per normal day are at least 3.0 in BINDING_LONG and at least 3.0 in ISOLATED_LATEST, with zero-signal days retained.
Whole-portfolio stressed 2x-cost net is positive and at least CONTROL in each of the two periods.
The combined appended sleeve stressed 2x-cost net and mean planned-risk-normalized stressed R are both positive in each period.
US30_CONVERGENCE and US500_CONVERGENCE each have positive stressed 2x-cost net in BINDING_LONG; latest evidence judges the inseparable combined sleeve only.
Each appended component supplies at least 25 percent of appended births in each period.
Native-six births retain at least 90 percent of CONTROL in each period.
Native-six stressed 2x-cost net in each period trails CONTROL by no more than max(5 USD, 10 percent of absolute CONTROL native-six stressed net).
Actual maximum equity drawdown in each period is no greater than max(CONTROL plus 2 USD, 110 percent of CONTROL).

fixed_verdict_rules.pass: PASS_CROSS_RELATIVE_CONVERGENCE_SLEEVE_RETAIN_PROSPECTIVE_LAB_CANDIDATE when integrity and every candidate requirement pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.falsified: NO_CROSS_RELATIVE_CONVERGENCE_SLEEVE_PASSED_PRESERVE_SIX_COMPONENTS when integrity passes and any candidate requirement fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_CROSS_RELATIVE_CONVERGENCE_SLEEVE_MATRIX_NO_VERDICT when the frozen semantic, source, compile, continuous-data, fingerprint, topology or density contract genuinely cannot be satisfied.
fixed_verdict_rules.no_partial_selection: No result can retain only US30 or only US500, and no component or period subgroup can override the bundle verdict.

decision_translation.pass: Freeze DUAL_APPEND as one prospective-only future Lab candidate. Because the available windows overlap legacy observation, require genuinely later uncontaminated evidence before any promotion decision. Do not touch Live.
decision_translation.falsified: Preserve the six-component forward baseline and close the entire convergence sleeve with no variant or retained question.
decision_translation.invalid: Preserve the baseline and make no economic statement. Environment repair is not the next research topic.

implementation_correction_governance.rule: Correct and record demonstrable parser, invocation, compile, serialization, runtime-copy or deterministic aggregation defects as internal Unit 093 audit events. They do not create experiments and do not become economic failures.
implementation_correction_governance.partial_matrix_rule: If a pure implementation defect or fingerprint drift is discovered after any path, discard the entire incomplete matrix without using its economic outcome, re-freeze the unchanged implementation and restart all four paths fresh. Never patch one favorable or unfavorable path in place.
implementation_correction_governance.invalidity_rule: Invalidity is based on genuine inability to satisfy the declared semantic, continuous-data, fingerprint, topology or density contract, never on exhausting a repair count.

stop_rules: Commit and push the declaration, retention receipt, state and Frontier memory before the one-time baseline or runtime copy.
Commit and push the frozen self-contained source/configuration, compile receipt and runtime receipt before the first valid matrix path.
Run all paths serially in declared order. Inspect only integrity and fingerprint continuity needed to proceed; aggregate economic comparisons once after the complete valid matrix.
Implementation repair stays inside Unit 093, has no arbitrary numeric cap and cannot change any signal, profile, period, order, risk, stop, cost, metric, gate, verdict or exclusion.
Do not open the six-hour branch, a one-symbol profile, a threshold, scale, clock, hold, direction, peer, risk, slot, stop, exit, period or subgroup rescue.
Do not modify the forward baseline, lab/mt5, Live, dashboard or Program 6 and do not query broker/account/position/order/deal state.
